findings.textured_copy_alpha: Control (white untextured square, then a textured square copying the previous frame): centre is white already at frame 0, when the previous frame is black. The copy is therefore weighted by texture alpha (src.a = vertex.a * texture.a; the canvas alpha starts at 0). The canvas alpha channel is a separate state: decay scales RGB only, and blending updates alpha by src.a^2 + dst.a*(1-src.a) or src.a^2 + dst.a. Not yet modelled by the illustrator.
